title: Gemini app gains new ‘Map’ tool, replacing ‘/’ with ‘@’
key_facts: Google has introduced a 'Map' tool in the Gemini app on Android and iOS; it is not available on the web.
It sits at the end of the carousel next to Photos, Camera, Avatar, Files, Drive and Notebooks.
It shows a live map of the user's current location with a circular focus area; users can pan, zoom and search for any location.
After choosing an area and pressing 'Explore this area', a 'Map Area' item is added to the prompt box where users can add text.
9to5Google says the Map tool is widely rolled out.
In the latest Google app beta (version 17.63), Gemini replaces the '/' used to invoke skills with the '@' symbol already used for Connected Apps, which will soon be renamed 'Connectors'.
Google announced on Wednesday (30 Sep 2026) that skills will replace Gems; the '@' change is not widely rolled out yet.
quote_evidence: Google has introduced a “Map” tool to aid your location-based Gemini app prompts on Android and iOS.
The Map tool is widely rolled out.
This change is not widely rolled out yet.
why_it_matters_hint: Gemini phone users can now pick a map area and ask about it, a small interface addition.
event_date: Not stated; published 2 Oct 2026. The skills-replace-Gems announcement was 30 Sep 2026.
notes: The '@' change comes from reading a beta app, so it may change before release.
